CESI LINEACT is offering a fully funded PhD position (starting October 2026, Pau, France) on Semantic Data Compression for Extended Reality (XR) in the aeronautic industry :

* Profile: Ing./Master’s students in Computer Science, Engineering, Networking, AI, XR, Embedded Systems, or related fields with strong interest in semantic communications, and edge/cloud computing.
* Research topics: Semantic Compression, Extended Reality (AR/VR), Edge Computing, Digital Twins, AI, Industry 5.0
* Funding: France 2030 - Campus Aero Adour (C2A)
* Laboratory: CESI LINEACT (UR 7527)
* Workplace: CESI, 6 Rue Saint-John Perse, 64000 Pau, France.
* Start Date: October 2026.
* Duration: 3 years
* Full PhD description : here<

>

Please share this opportunity with interested students and research networks.
